# BDI Association Roles

BDI defines Common Roles as the standardized roles for activities in a specific sector or type of supply chain. They form the basis for standardized role-based authorizations.

This type of roles is sector specific, as opposed to BDI Roles that are part of the building blocks. Common roles define operational responsibilities within supply chains, helping to create standardized Data Access Policies.

Members of different Associations that have different policies per common role will need to align these policies and roles to become interoperable.
